title: scRNA-seq clustering benchmark with F1 and AUROC
abstract: We benchmark single-cell RNA-seq clustering using scanpy across datasets, reporting F1 score and adjusted Rand index for each method.

title: Variant pathogenicity prediction pipeline
abstract: A ClinVar-based variant annotation model evaluated with AUROC and precision-recall. Code and data released for reproduction.

title: Purely wet-lab study of a signaling pathway
abstract: We characterize a signaling pathway in mouse models using western blot and immunohistochemistry. No computational method is proposed.

title: Protein structure prediction with contact maps and RMSD
abstract: A deep learning folding method evaluated by TM-score and RMSD on a benchmark dataset. Pipeline accepts FASTA and outputs PDB.

title: Paywalled classification method
abstract: A classifier for disease subtypes with F1 evaluation. Behind a paywall.

title: Phylogenetic tree inference benchmark
abstract: We compare maximum-likelihood phylogenetic methods on alignment datasets, reporting Robinson-Foulds accuracy.

title: Histology image segmentation with Dice
abstract: Cellpose-based segmentation of histology microscopes images evaluated by Dice and Jaccard on a public dataset.

title: A 2025 method (post-cutoff)
abstract: Recent single-cell pipeline with F1 metrics and open code, published after the training cutoff.

title: Restrictive license bioinformatics tool
abstract: A gene regulatory network inference tool with AUROC evaluation, but under a non-commercial-only restrictive license.

title: Regression model for drug response with RMSE
abstract: We train a regression model predicting drug response, evaluated by RMSE and Pearson correlation on a benchmark dataset with cross-validation.

title: Ambiguous study without computational keywords
abstract: We survey clinicians about their data practices and summarize responses qualitatively in a cross-sectional study of hospital workflows.
